exposure: urethral sling surgery using a surgeon-tailored polypropylene mesh
cohort: 100 randomly selected patients submitted to transobturator sling surgery using a tailored polypropylene mesh at the Santa Casa de Misericordia Hospital in Vitoria, Espirito Santo, Brazil, between 2009 and 2014
finding: The use of a surgeon-tailored polypropylene mesh in urethral sling surgery is a safe, inexpensive option, with few complications and a consequent improvement in patients' quality of life.
